source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.2, kinetic theory of gases (PDF 5-6).

blocks.text: Kinetic theory of gases batati hai ke gas kin molecules se bani hai aur woh kaise motion (harkat) karte hain. Is theory mein gas ka pressure particles ke aapas mein aur container (bartan) ki deewaron se takrane se paida hota hai. Yeh theory temperature, volume aur pressure jaisi properties (khoobiyan) bhi samjhati hai, aur transport properties (cheezein ek jagah se doosri jagah pohanchane wali khoobiyan) bhi, jaise viscosity (gaarhapan), thermal conductivity (heat guzarne ki salahiyat) aur diffusivity (phailne ki salahiyat).
Kinetic molecular theory ideal gases par lagu hoti hai aur pichhli class mein parhai ja chuki hai. Phir bhi is ke basic assumptions (pehle se maan li gayi baatein) yeh hain:

items: Gas bohat zyada number mein bohat chhote, gol (spherical) particles se bani hai. Yeh particles apne size ke muqable mein ek doosre se bohat door hain.
Gas ke particles hamesha tez motion mein hain, har taraf random (be-tarteeb) directions mein.
Gas ke particles ki container ki deewaron se takkarein perfectly elastic (poori tarah lachakdar) hain, yani kinetic energy zaya nahi hoti.
Jab tak particles aapas mein takrayein nahi, un ke darmiyan na attraction (kashish) hai na repulsion (dhakelna).
Gas ke particles ki average kinetic energy gas ke temperature par depend karti hai (temperature se tay hoti hai).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Hawa ke ek chhote se 'cube' mein 10²⁰ tak molecules ho sakte hain. Gas ke particles ka apna volume un ke beech khali jagah ke volume ke muqable mein negligible (na hone ke barabar) hai.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: Mean free path woh average distance (faasla) hai jo chalta hua particle aisi takkar se pehle tay karta hai jo us ki direction ya energy ko kaafi badal de.

blocks.prompt: Kinetic theory ka kaun sa assumption batata hai ke gas apna poora container kyun bhar deti hai?
blocks.explanation: Particles hamesha tez, random motion mein hain aur (takkar ke ilawa) ek doosre ko attract nahi karte (nahi kheenchte). Is liye woh container ki saari khali jagah mein phail jate hain.

items: Kinetic theory: gas ka pressure particles ki takkaron se.
Assumptions: bohat chhote, door door particles; random tez motion; elastic takkarein; takkar ke ilawa koi force nahi; average K.E. temperature par depend karti hai.
Mean free path: do bari takkaron ke darmiyan average distance.
